cases.title: Initial load and tab switching for Register a Car
cases.description: Verify that upon initial load, the 'Register a Car' form is visible, and clicking the 'Register Car' tab button multiple times keeps the form visible, hides the 'View All Registrations' table, and correctly toggles the 'active' class.

cases.title: Tab switching and idempotency for View All Registrations
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'View All Registrations' tab button shows the registrations table, hides the register form, updates the 'active' classes accordingly, and maintains state correctly on multiple repeated clicks.

cases.title: Successful car registration submission and form reset
cases.description: Verify that filling out all required fields ('owner-name-input', 'car-model-input', 'license-number-input', 'registration-date-input') and clicking 'submit-button' saves the data to localStorage under 'registrations', updates the table, and resets the form inputs.

cases.title: Validation failure on incomplete car registration form
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Save Registration' button with one or more empty fields triggers an alert with the message 'Please fill out all fields.' and does not save the data.

cases.title: Dynamic population of table from localStorage on view tab navigation
cases.description: Verify that navigating to the 'View All Registrations' tab correctly populates 'registration-table' with rows for each saved registration from localStorage, or renders an empty table body if no registrations exist.

cases.title: Deletion of car registration from table and localStorage
cases.description: Verify that clicking the delete button ('delete-btn-0') for the first row registration successfully removes it from localStorage and updates the table view to exclude the deleted entry.

opinions.feedback: All proposed test cases completely cover the requirements with clear, distinct scenarios, proper risk assessment, and well-defined testability. No blockers found.
All cases are clear, well-defined, and map directly to the specified requirements.

analysis.analysis: e2edev_bench_20-R-1: Testable behaviors include initial load visibility of 'register-tab-content', clicking 'register-tab-button' to show content and hide 'view-tab-content', idempotency on multiple clicks, and dynamic 'active' class toggling. Boundaries: initial state vs clicked state. Normal path: load -> register tab visible. Abnormal path: none explicitly defined. Ambiguities: exact styling of 'active' class beyond its presence. e2edev_bench_20-R-2: Testable behaviors include clicking 'view-tab-button' to show 'view-tab-content', hide 'register-tab-content', apply 'active' class to view button, remove from register button, and handle multiple clicks idempotently. Boundaries: switching between tabs. Normal path: register active -> view active. Abnormal path: none. e2edev_bench_20-R-3: Testable behaviors include presence of fields ('owner-name-input', 'car-model-input', 'license-number-input', 'registration-date-input'), validation on 'submit-button' click, saving to localStorage under 'registrations', updating 'registration-table', resetting form, and showing alert 'Please fill out all fields.' if empty. Button functionality tied to active register tab. Boundaries: all fields filled vs any field empty. Normal path: fill all -> save -> clear -> table update -> localStorage write. Abnormal path: empty fields -> alert -> no save. e2edev_bench_20-R-5: Testable behaviors include populating 'registration-table' from localStorage when switching to view tab, handling empty localStorage gracefully (empty table body), and ensuring correct visibility states. Boundaries: empty vs populated localStorage. Normal path: load stored data into table rows. e2edev_bench_20-R-8: Testable behaviors include deleting a registration via 'delete-btn-0', removing it from localStorage under 'registrations', and updating the table view. Boundaries: table with multiple/single rows vs empty table after deletion. Normal path: click delete -> remove from storage -> refresh table UI.
